claims: There are five 2026 Oscar nominees for Best Original Song.
"Golden" from KPop Demon Hunters is a 2026 Oscar nominee for Best Original Song.
"I Lied to You" from Sinners is a 2026 Oscar nominee for Best Original Song.
"Dear Me" (Diane Warren: Relentless) is a 2026 Oscar nominee for Best Original Song.
"Sweet Dreams of Joy" (Viva Verdi!) is a 2026 Oscar nominee for Best Original Song.
"Train Dreams" (Train Dreams) is a 2026 Oscar nominee for Best Original Song.
